Participants, procedure and measures
Students wrote an argumentative text in five parts and received either AI-generated feedback or self-feedback prompts. The analysis measures writing self-efficacy and examines baseline writing skill and four goal orientations: mastery, performance approach, performance avoidance and work avoidance.

What the paper reports
scope-02
result
Result
The paper reports a near-zero average contrast. Students higher in performance approach or avoidance showed lower self-efficacy with AI feedback relative to self-feedback, with stronger evidence for avoidance. Work avoidance did not show a clear interaction. The mastery pattern depended on writing skill, but was sensitive to how standard errors were estimated.
